top_signals.title: Spain Foresees Higher Energy Prices Due to Iran War

top_signals.title: Tribunal thumbs up £260m legal settlement against Google
top_signals.summary: A UK specialist court has greenlit a £260m settlement in a class action against Google’s parent company, Alphabet, following an agreement last week.
